label: Shan Hai Scrolls
layer_order: above frame ornament, below killer/victim portraits; clip all effects out of actual portrait masks
blend: source-over baseline; optional linear-light additive with alpha applied once

timeline.clock: seconds relative to kill output timestamp
timeline.pre_kill: texture opacity=0 for t<0; existing optional anticipation is separate

design_brief: Sweeping ivory-white, warm gold and teal cloudlike brush trails, a few vermilion accents and fine ink-style splattered fragments, matching the actual reference's gold/white/teal cloud and dragon curves. Open negative space, no landscape, no paper disk or rectangle.
limits: This is one combined peak texture; individual particles are not separately controllable within it.
Do not replace or modify frame PNG; keep this on a separate effect layer.
Review material, not a final approved game integration.
Existing frame images may themselves contain quality defects; reference use does not approve them.
qa_warnings: Outer-edge alpha residue; strict transparent-margin check pending repair
